Hi Emma — great to hear from you. Thanks for the constraints; we can absolutely run a 60-minute live demo. A couple notes on timezones / daylight savings:
- Redwood demo engineers for this account are in Berlin (CEST, currently UTC+2).
- US west coast (PST) is UTC-8 or PDT UTC-7 depending on DST. In mid-March DST starts in the US (Mar 14), so from Mar 16 your local time will be PDT (UTC-7). That makes e.g. 9:00 AM PDT = 18:00 CEST.

Proposed slots (all are 60 mins):
- Tue Mar 16: 09:00 PDT / 18:00 CEST (Mar 16 17:00 UTC)
- Wed Mar 17: 10:00 PDT / 19:00 CEST (Mar 17 18:00 UTC)
- Thu Mar 18: 11:00 PDT / 20:00 CEST (Mar 18 19:00 UTC)

We realize those are late evenings for the EU team — Vivek (SE) and Rachel (CS) are on the thread and can confirm availability. If those slots are too late for our engineers we can also offer an earlier EU-friendly time by bringing in a US-based solutions engineer on weekdays (slightly less deep demo but good for initial overview).

I've attached a short timezone conversion guide and I'll follow up with an invite once we confirm the slot.
